Seeking a Security Advisor to join a high-performing Security team within a leading Defence organisation.   Your new company     
 Our client is a highly regarded Australian defence organisation delivering advanced technology and capability solutions to support national security outcomes. Operating within a complex and highly secure environment, the organisation is committed to maintaining the highest standards of protective security, safety and compliance. 
 We are seeking a Security Advisor to join a high-performing Protective Security team in Canberra, providing day-to-day security support across a range of protective security disciplines. This is an excellent opportunity for a candidate holding a current Positive Vetting (PV) clearance to further develop their career within the Defence Industry. 
   Your new role     
 Reporting to the Senior Security Advisor, you will provide operational security support and subject matter expertise across a range of protective security functions. Your responsibilities will include: 
 
 Providing advice across security governance, personnel, physical, communications and information security disciplines 
 Supporting Defence Industry Security Program (DISP) obligations and Security Officer functions 
 Assisting with the maintenance of external security accreditations, licences and compliance requirements 
 Preparing incident reports and liaising with relevant external agencies 
 Reviewing and updating security policies, procedures and governance documentation 
 Managing security administration activities and security-related records 
 Supporting the management of security systems, access controls, CCTV, alarms, key management and secure storage arrangements 
 Building effective relationships with internal stakeholders, contractors and government agencies. 
 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 To be successful in this role, you will possess: 
 
 A current AGSVA Positive Vetting (PV) security clearance 
 Experience working within a Defence or Defence Industry environment 
 Knowledge and experience across one or more protective security disciplines 
 Understanding of PSPF, DISP, AGSVA clearance processes and security risk management principles 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to prepare high-quality reports and documentation 
 Experience managing security systems, visitor management, access control or related security operations 
 Relevant security qualifications such as Certificate III/IV in Security Operations, Defence Security Officer training or equivalent. 
 
 Willingness to work from the office five days per week 
 
 
    What you'll get in return     
 
 Permanent opportunity with a leading Defence Industry organisation 
 Exposure to complex and high-profile national security projects 
 Supportive and collaborative security team environment 
 Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities 
 Canberra-based position requiring a current PV clearance. 
 
   What you need to do now     
 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or for a confidential discussion please contact Tayla Bennett on 02 6112 7617 or email Tayla.bennett@hays.com.au 
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.    Please  click here  to apply.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
Security Duties

Patrol the Sports Club premises during operating and after-hours periods.
Monitor and control access to the club and surrounding facilities.
Ensure the safety and security of members, visitors, staff, and property.
Respond to incidents, disturbances, emergencies, or suspicious behaviour.
Conduct routine security inspections and report hazards or maintenance issues.
Secure buildings, doors, windows, and equipment at the end of each shift.
Maintain incident logs and complete security reports when required.
Liaise with management, emergency services, and local authorities when necessary.
Enforce club rules and promote a safe and respectful environment.

Cleaning Duties

Clean and maintain club facilities including halls, offices, toilets, kitchens, and outdoor areas.
Sweep, mop, vacuum, and disinfect floors and surfaces.
Empty rubbish bins and dispose of waste appropriately.
Clean and restock toilet facilities with supplies.
Wipe down furniture, tables, benches, and high-contact surfaces.
Ensure outdoor areas are free of litter and hazards.
Report damaged equipment, maintenance issues, or cleaning supply shortages.
Follow workplace health and safety procedures when handling cleaning chemicals and equipment.

Do you want a career that means more? At Anglicare Sydney, we bring the strength, the support and the strategy to make it happen. 

For over 170 years, Anglicare has supported people and communities across Sydney and the surrounds. Our Seniors Communities portfolio spans Retirement Living and Support at Home services, supporting thousands of older Australians and their families. 

AsControls and Design Assurance Manager,you'llplay a critical leadership role in safeguarding Anglicare's digital assets,dataand IT infrastructure.You'lllead the Cyber Security Controls Assurance Program, ensuring security controls are designed,testedandmaintainedfor operational effectiveness and compliance.You'llbe welcomed into a compassionate,respectfuland purpose-driven community where wedon'tjust talk about values - we live them.

As part of a purpose-driven organisation, you'll be working in a collaborative and values-led environment where your work directly contributes to enriching lives and strengthening communities. 

Your opportunity

You will lead a team of cyber security professionals and collaborate with IT, legal, compliance and senior leadership to align cyber securitycontrols operational effectivenesswithAnglicare'soverall security posture. From architectural security reviews to vulnerability management and data protection initiatives,you'llensure robust security frameworks that protect our mission.

With ownership, you will:

Develop and oversee Anglicare's Security Controls Assurance Program

Lead security architecture reviews and risk-based design assessments

Ensure secure Identity Governance, Data Loss Protection and Privileged Access Management

Standardise cloud and network security controls across hybrid environments

Oversee vulnerability management and risk mitigation programs

Implement secure DevOps frameworks and compliance in development pipelines

Engage senior stakeholders and provide compliance reporting

What you'll bring

You are a strategic leader with deepexpertisein cyber security controls,governanceand risk management. You bring strong analytical skills, excellentcommunicationand the ability to translate complex security concepts into actionable strategies.

You will also need:

Tertiary qualification in IT, Cyber Security or Risk Management

Proven experience in cyber security, controls assurance and risk governance

Familiarity withCyber Security Frameworks such as SCF(preferred), NIST and ISO 27001

Strong leadership and stakeholder engagement skills

Ability toadvisesenior leadership on cyber security risk and compliance

Why Anglicare?

At Anglicare, we provide meaningful opportunities and choice - both for the communities we support and the people who work with us. 

Here'swhatyou'llenjoy: 

Flexible work options to balance life and career. 

Salary packaging benefits - up to $15,900 of your income tax free, plus $2,650 for meals and entertainment. 

Ongoing professional development and career pathways.

Belonging to a supportive, purpose-driven team committed to making a difference.

All applicants will receive a response. Anglicare is as wonderfully diverse as the communities we serve. While guided by our Christian values, our team includes people of all faiths and backgrounds.

We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all ages, genders,abilitiesand cultural backgrounds.
